summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: /give @s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm$$Lambda$3043/1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm$$Lambda$1477/601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and enter a world.  
2. Open the chat and execute the command ``/give @s jigsaw``.  
3. Place the received jigsaw block and right‑click it to open its user interface.  
4. In any of the text boxes, type an invalid character such as `:` or `{}`.  
5. Press the Enter key.  
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior: The actual behavior observed is that after giving the player a jigsaw block and opening its configuration screen, typing characters such as < > { } or any Unicode symbol that is not a lowercase letter, digit, slash, period, underscore or hyphen into any of the text fields prevents the Done button from becoming active. When the player presses the Enter key despite the button being disabled, the client crashes immediately. The crash report generated for version 1.14.3‑pre3 shows a keyPressed event handler error indicating a non‑allowed character in the path of location minecraft:empty and lists a stack trace that includes methods qt at source line 38, qt at source line 43, dbo.d at line 44, dbo.b at line 35, dbo.keyPressed at line 106, cvm.a at line 410, a lambda in cvm, czx.wrapScreenError at line 441, additional cvm calls, the GLFW key callback, the native GLFW poll events call, and finally the main method in net.minecraft.client.main.Main. This behavior contrasts with the expected outcome where entering text should either accept only valid characters or display an error without terminating the game.
Expected Behavior: When the player gives themselves a jigsaw block, opens its UI, enters characters such as “:” or “{}” into any text field and then presses Enter, the interface should simply reject the invalid input (e.g., keep the Done button disabled or show an error) and the game should continue running without generating a crash or error report.
